\caption{Pool support before and after expansion for zone 112011236, the worked example used in the audit. Each square is one positive-target control cell in the zone's 19 control tables; rows are tables and columns are the cells present in that table. Blue cells already supply at least the carrier capacity the fitter needs, red cells supply nothing, and green cells were red before expansion and are supplied after it. The zone's slice grows by only 347 persons (1.0\%) and 98 households, but the number of unreachable target cells falls from 9 to 1; the cell that remains is the structural code \texttt{qalfp:16}, for which the extract has no resident donor.}
\label{fig:pool_before_after}
\end{figure}
